aiStrategyRevisionId.description: Use the exact current revision for a restart. This update tool has NO top-level source or liveCadenceMatchesBacktest parameters: never send either field. Those names are fields inside scheduleMetadata only for an explicitly requested schedule change, not for a preserved-schedule restart.

brokerCredentialId.description: Exact saved broker ID from authoritative deployment evidence when keeping its account. If unavailable, omit it and tell the owner to confirm/select the named account on the approval page. An omitted ID is not a prefilled selection.

envVarSetIds.description: For a restart keeping saved variables, this field must contain the matching active item.id values from saved_env_vars(action="list"). Copy that returned ID array into this field before calling. Omission or [] selects none; neither preserves the saved variables. Never say variables are prefilled when this array was omitted.
